frozen_question: After a repair/fibrotic state is already established, can delayed mechanical or ECM-stabilization retuning causally shift resolution/regeneration without disrupting necessary early repair?
strict_requirements: delayed intervention begins after the relevant repair state is demonstrably established
mechanical/ECM state is directly perturbed, not merely a downstream transcriptional program
mechanical state is quantified before/after intervention by modulus, force, crosslinking or another explicit physical-state readout
same-state cellular trajectory or scar-resolution readout changes
structural or functional tissue outcome improves without evidence of destabilized early repair

evidence_roots.timing: anti-LOXL2 started after 6 weeks of already-established TAA fibrosis and also tested during recovery
evidence_roots.mechanical_physical_readout: collagen crosslinking / insoluble collagen fraction and fibrotic septal architecture
evidence_roots.outcome: less matrix stabilization/bridging and accelerated early fibrosis reversal

evidence_roots.paper: Mechanical Environment Afforded by Engineered Hydrogel Critically Regulates Survival of Neural Stem Cells Transplanted in the Injured Spinal Cord via Piezo1-Mediated Mechanotransduction
evidence_roots.timing: NSC+hydrogel transplantation at 7 days after contusive SCI
evidence_roots.mechanical_perturbation: 10%, 13% and 16% I-5 hydrogels; 16% approximately fivefold stiffer than 10% and approximately 9.3 kPa at 37 C
evidence_roots.mechanistic_test: Piezo1 pharmacology/siRNA in vitro and CRISPR/Cas9 Piezo1 editing in transplanted NSCs in vivo
evidence_roots.outcome: stiffer hydrogel substantially increased graft survival
evidence_roots.why_not_core: the principal endpoint is survival of an exogenous NSC graft, not endogenous scar-state EXIT/resolution or whole-tissue functional recovery

evidence_roots.paper: Early and Delayed Tranilast Treatment Reduces Pathological Fibrosis Following Myocardial Infarction
evidence_roots.result: early antifibrotic treatment exacerbated infarct expansion, whereas delayed day-7 treatment reduced later fibrosis/remodeling without detriment to infarct healing

evidence_roots.paper: Specialized fibroblast differentiated states underlie scar formation in the infarcted mouse heart
evidence_roots.result: LOX inhibition with BAPN disrupted collagen maturation and prolonged alpha-SMA-positive myofibroblast state to day 14, supporting that matrix maturation can be required for normal fibroblast-state transition/EXIT
evidence_roots.boundary: do not infer that matrix softening or crosslink inhibition is always beneficial

evidence_roots.paper: Lysyl oxidase promotes bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis through modulating inflammation
evidence_roots.timing: BAPN from day 7 to 21 after bleomycin challenge, a therapeutic/fibrogenic-stage window
evidence_roots.result: reduced fibrosis, TGF-beta signaling and myofibroblast accumulation, but less strongly than preventive treatment

evidence_roots.evidence: Trps1 induction during POD7-17 initial-scarring interval can still reduce scar phenotype and support regenerative features

examples: neonatal-like softening can favor endogenous axon regrowth in one SCI scaffold system
a stiffer delayed I-5 hydrogel improves transplanted NSC survival in another SCI system
cardiac collagen maturation can facilitate exit from the alpha-SMA myofibroblast state
late inhibition of pathological collagen crosslink stabilization can accelerate reversal of established liver fibrosis
cross_evidence_interpretation.best_supported_rule: The relevant variable is whether the mechanical/ECM state is appropriate for the current repair phase and cell identity, not whether the tissue is simply softer or stiffer.

gate_decision.reason: No two independent tissues yet satisfy all frozen requirements simultaneously. Liver provides the strongest delayed established-matrix reversal experiment but lacks direct longitudinal modulus/function; delayed spinal-cord mechanics is causal for graft survival rather than endogenous resolution.
gate_decision.claim_ceiling: Delayed manipulation of ECM/mechanical state can remain biologically effective after injury states are established, and its effect depends on phase and target-cell identity. A universal delayed mechanical-resolution window is not yet established.

next_killer_targets: skin: delayed offloading/mechanical buffering or mechanotransduction intervention started after alpha-SMA-positive myofibroblasts are established, with tissue mechanics and closure-strength readouts
spinal cord: delayed mechanical retuning of the endogenous lesion after scar/lesion stiffness is measured, without requiring an exogenous graft
heart: delayed post-stabilization ECM/crosslink or mechanotransduction perturbation paired with scar modulus, activated-fibroblast state and rupture/remodeling endpoints
liver: delayed LOXL2/crosslink perturbation repeated with longitudinal AFM/rheology and liver-function/regenerative readouts
upgrade_rule: v0.2 requires two independent tissues satisfying every strict requirement; at least one must be HEART, SKIN, SPINAL_CORD or TENDON.
